description: Compute the Korean Four Pillars of Destiny (사주팔자 / Bazi) from a solar birthdate. Returns the year/month/day/hour pillars (heavenly stem + earthly branch, with hanja), the five-element distribution (wood/fire/earth/metal/water), the Day Master, and the zodiac animal.

hour.description: Birth hour in 24h time (0–23). Use -1 if the hour is unknown.

lang.description: Output language (default ko). One of: ko, en, ja, zh, es, pt-br, vi, id, hi, th

name: saju_calculate
title: Calculate Saju (Four Pillars)
